items.statement: NVMe I/O dispatch validates the namespace and routes BBSSD READ and WRITE opcodes through bb_nvme_rw into the shared nvme_rw path.
nvme_rw computes the exclusive ending LBA, calls femu_nvme_rw_check_req, and immediately returns the validation error when that end exceeds namespace size.
An exclusive ending LBA beyond namespace size returns NVME_LBA_RANGE with NVME_DNR.
A transfer larger than the controller MDTS limit returns NVME_INVALID_FIELD with NVME_DNR.
The FTL invokes opcode handlers only when the request status is NVME_SUCCESS.
The submission poller initializes request completion, DSM, timing, and command fields before storing the dispatch status.
The FTL stores its selected latency and adds it to the request expiration time.
The submission poller removes a request from the SQ free list and initializes it, while completion posts its CQE and returns the same request to that free list.
The zero-based NLB field is converted to a block count by adding one, and the exclusive end LBA is computed as SLBA plus that count.
Non-inline requests, including validation failures, cross from the poller to the FTL ring and back through the per-poller completion ring.
An out-of-range ending LBA records an NVME_LBA_RANGE error-page entry before returning the error with DNR.
A failed dispatch frees any allocated DSM ranges and clears their request fields before completion.
An NVMe request whose exclusive end LBA exceeds namespace size records an error-page entry and returns NVME_LBA_RANGE with NVME_DNR.
items.description: An NVMe request whose end LBA exceeds the namespace size records an error and returns NVME_LBA_RANGE with NVME_DNR.
